{{Quote|There. A ship just dropped out of hyperspace in this system.|Darth Nyriss locates the ''Ebon Hawk'' entering the Nathema system|<ref name="Revan" />}}
The '''Nathema system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]]. Containing the vibrant [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Nathema]], originally named Medriaas, the system supplied the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] with [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] before the Empire's destruction in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Nathema's ruler, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], subsequently [[Ritual of Nathema|annihilated]] all life on Nathema with a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]], leaving the star system barren and lifeless. As [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitued Sith Empire]], Vitiate erased all navigational data on the Nathema system in order to hide the evidence of his crimes, and the system received only a few scattered visitors throughout the following millennia as a result.

==Description==
{{Quote|He spent his childhood on Nathema, a lush and vibrant agricultural world on the far fringes of the Empire.|Darth Nyriss, on the history of the Emperor|<ref name="Revan" />}}
The Nathema system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]] in [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> on the far eastern edges of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]&mdash;a region that fell within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] at that point in [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;in the centuries before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A system with a radius of several million [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]], it contained an [[Nathema's sun|orange]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Star/Legends|star]] that was orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]], a fertile [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] originally known as Medriaas. However, the system was marked by the absence of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself.<ref name="Revan" />

==History==
{{Quote|We're headed into the Unknown Regions, to a planet called Nathema.|Revan|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Colonized by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] well before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5113 BBY]], the Nathema system was within the territory of the Sith Empire and therefore supplied the Empire with [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] produced by the many villages on Medriaas' surface. However, the ruling [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath]] was [[Medriaas revolution|overthrown]] by his young illegitimate son [[Tenebrae]], and the thirteen-year-old boy was granted his father's throne in [[5100 BBY/Legends|5100 BBY]] by the current [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and ruler of the Empire, [[Marka Ragnos]]. Renaming his world Nathema, the newly-appointed Lord Vitiate kept the Nathema system largely unaffected by traditional [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] infighting during the century of his rule, and when the Great Hyperspace War began with the Republic in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] he chose to keep himself and Nathema out of the fighting. As a result, Nathema escaped the widespread destruction that wracked the Empire in the aftermath of the Republic's victory, and Vitiate summoned all of the remaining Sith Lords to Nathema<ref name="Revan" /> in [[4999 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> with the promise of the Empire's salvation and the destruction of the Republic's hated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protectors.<ref name="Revan" />

[[File:Nathema_system_and_shuttle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nathema received few visitors in the aftermath of the ritual.]]
However, Vitiate instead took mental control of the eight thousand Sith who answered his call and forced them to participate in a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] that stripped the very life from the entire planet, leaving Nathema literally lifeless except for Vitiate. Blaming the [[Ritual of Nathema|destruction]] of his planet on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Vitiate led the remnants of the shattered Empire on a twenty-year [[Sith exodus|exodus]] that ended with the rediscovery of the lost colony [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Declaring himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Vitiate purged all [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] navigational data that related to the Nathema system, ensuring that none of his new subjects could return to the system and discover the truth. However, sometime before [[3954 BBY]], several members of the new Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] had discovered the Nathema system and the Emperor's past, and they [[Nathema conspiracy|formed a plot]] to unseat him.<ref name="Revan" />

In [[3960 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] discovered the Nathema system while searching for the mysterious Sith influence that had manipulated the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture into declaring [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] on the Republic, and the pair's visit to Nathema drove them to try and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor once they discovered the route to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, the Emperor broke the two Jedi and sent them back to the Republic as his servants, though the pair broke free of his control and declared their [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|own empire]]. Revan was wiped of his memories and retrained as a Jedi by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] during the subsequent [[Jedi Civil War]], but after he defeated Malak in battle and ended the conflict, he began to be plagued by his broken memories and eventually rediscovered the path to Nathema. At the same time, the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]] inducted the Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] into the conspiracy by showing him Nathema, and the pair were departing the system when Revan arrived in his ship the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''. Nyriss and Scourge shot down the ''Ebon Hawk'' with an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and captured Revan, but his [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] companion [[T3-M4]] was able to repair the ''Hawk'' over the next few years and return to the Republic.<ref name="Revan" />

T3-M4 returned to the Nathema system with Revan's friend and ally [[Meetra Surik]] in [[3950 BBY]], and the two were able to locate a hyperspace route to Dromund Kaas within the remains of Nathema's governmental database.<ref name="Revan" /> Besides these sporadic visits, the star system remained unknown and barren, and its location at the edge of the galaxy did little to attract the attention of major galactic powers throughout the following centuries. During the [[New Sith Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and various Sith factions, the Nathema system was located within contested space, and it remained unaligned or contested throughout the next several centuries until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]], by which point the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] under the Sith Lord [[Darth Krayt]] had taken control of that region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Orbital bodies==
===Nathema===
{{Main|Nathema}}
Nathema, originally known as Medriaas, was a primitive agriworld colonized by the Sith species that supplied the Sith Empire with foodstuffs in the years before the Great Hyperspace War. The planet supported a significant population of farmers scattered across its surface in villages and the occasional city, but the Ritual of Nathema completely eliminated all life on the planet. Vitiate's ritual tore [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself from the environment, leeching color and sound and leaving everything a dull brown or gray color as well as causing [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals physical illness on account of the Force's absence.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nathema system first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2012]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'',<ref name="Revan" /> though it was not explicitly identified as the Nathema system until an update to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] of the [[2009]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in the Chorlian sector, with grid coordinates S-4.<ref name="EAOC" /> The book places the Nathema system in the Unknown Regions, though neither the novel nor the Companion specifies whether the Nathema system was also renamed when Medriaas was.<ref name="Revan" />
